metadata.definition: each server is occupied by exactly one tenant; assignments are as balanced as possible
metadata.task_size_rule: single dominant DP collective per tenant; msg_size is in bytes; task_size_bits = (msg_size_bytes * 8) / occupied_servers

qp_baseline.description: Meta-inspired QP message round robin and QP-aware ECMP; original default mapping
qp_baseline.harmonics: existing HarmonicsBaselineHeuristic offset search with QP-aware metadata and simulation callbacks
